title: H: Drive Worktree Consolidation — Land Stranded Commits + Fix Lint-Staged Root Cause
superseded_reason: Prevention-by-structure pivot. The recovery-tool framing of WORKTREE-CONSOLIDATE-MS0 (cherry-pick stranded commits, drain trees, fix lint-staged) addressed symptoms — the shared-tree commit-collision class kept recurring because there was no STRUCTURAL separation between concurrent chats. The 32-unit recovery-tool work is partially absorbed (lint-staged fix → U-LINTSTAGED-FIX; worktree drain → U-P2-DRAIN-BATCH-A/B + U-VIZ-WORKTREE-MAP family) — the remaining unfinished units are obsolete because the structural fix eliminated the class of bug they were targeting. See SLOT-WORKTREE-MS0 envelope for full traceability.
